//: The leaderboard is the only query in the app that sorts across users, and
every one of its four windows needs its own composite index: Firestore
cannot combine an equality filter with an ordering on a different field
without one. The `hidden` filter is what keeps an opted-out matchmaker off
the board, and the period key is what keeps last week's numbers out of this
week's — so both are part of every index.
The all-time board has no period key, so it needs one fewer field.
Two `isGreaterThan` filters run against these same indexes and need no
further index of their own, because a range on the field already being
ordered by is free: the `> 0` that keeps a member who published a zero
counter this morning off the board, and the `> myActions` that counts the
rows above the reader to find their rank.
